assignments.title: Prediction and model validation
assignments.outcome: Evaluate models using splits that respect economic timing and information availability.
assignments.specific_contract: Prediction target, information time and horizon; train/validation/test and rolling origin; learned preprocessing fitted inside splits; grouped versus temporal deployment targets; selection optimism; loss and baseline comparisons. Original exact forecast laboratory with timing/leakage mutation checks.

assignments.title: Time-series and panel data basics
assignments.outcome: Prepare longitudinal data and identify dependence and aggregation pitfalls.
assignments.specific_contract: Calendar-correct lags versus preceding row; entity-time keys/missingness/entry-exit and survivorship; stock/flow/rate aggregation and deflation; covariance stationarity versus trending/nonstationary examples with assumptions; no generic stationarity proof from a plot. Reproducible synthetic time/panel lab.

assignments.title: Computational reliability and numerical audits
assignments.outcome: Verify outputs through invariants, simple cases and independent calculations.
assignments.specific_contract: Reliability of actual computational claims: invariants, independent reference methods, units, zero/boundaries, explicit input validation versus removable assert, absolute/relative precision, cancellation/conditioning versus algorithm stability; executable audit laboratory and deliberately broken variants detected. Complement earlier v02-c12 rather than merely repeat it.

assignments.title: Empirical integration and replication
assignments.outcome: Reproduce a small empirical result and document departures from the original analysis.
assignments.specific_contract: Actually reproduce a small externally sourced empirical descriptive result with primary public data frozen locally and documented provenance, units/vintage/access/license; reconstruction and discrepancy log, prespecified robustness and limits. Do not present a synthetic-only case as empirical replication. A bounded official historical statistical result plus original reconstruction is acceptable; avoid copyrighted large datasets. Supply exact expected original versus reconstructed output and independent checks.
